response.sql: SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(sc.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY (AVG(sc.pressratio) IS NULL), AVG(sc.pressratio) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Ties in average compression ratio are broken arbitrarily because the request gives no secondary sort key. Scans with a NULL scancount are excluded by the >= 11 filter.
